name: Fletcher Building Limited
summary: Fletcher Building Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes building products in New Zealand, Australia, and internationally. It operates through Light Building Products; Heavy Building Materials; Distribution; and Residential and Development segments. The company manufactures, distributes, and markets light building products, including plasterboard, laminates and panels, insulation, and plastic and concrete piping, as well as steel products, drywall systems, and associated products and services used in residential, industrial, and commercial markets.
